verdict.rationale: Edge0 documents an `edge0 serve` command that exposes an OpenAI-compatible /v1/chat/completions HTTP endpoint, with a curl example. It also documents a programmatic Python API (AutoEngine/AutoModel/AutoConfig `from_pretrained`), so agents and scripts can drive the engine directly. Missing for 10: a dedicated API reference (endpoints beyond chat completions, request parameters, streaming/auth details), documentation beyond README snippets, and independent or hands-on corroboration that the API works as described.
